verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents a first-party hosted MCP endpoint: discovery at `/.well-known/mcp`, then `/api/mcp` for WebMCP. External agents can connect to it, but the documented methods are only `initialize` and resource listing/reading, so it looks like read-only content access rather than tools for operating LobeHub agents. The `/mcp` page itself is a marketplace directory of third-party servers, and the local MCP connectors are client-side, so neither is credited here. Missing for 10: documented MCP tools for acting on the LobeHub workspace, auth and setup docs for connecting external agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: start from `/.well-known/mcp` (discovery), then call `/api/mcp` for WebMCP (`initialize`, `resources/list`, `resources/read`).
